text:
Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance form: part I
The first part of the Maritime Labour Certificate; this form identifies the topics for inspection.
Documents
Details
The ‘Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance’ (DMLC-Part I) form is to be filled in by the attending surveyor.
DMLC-Part I:
- identifies the topics for inspection
- lists the relevant pieces of legislation putting the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 (MLC) in place
- lists any ‘Substantial Equivalents’ and exemptions that have been granted
Read Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance Part II and Guidance for further information.
